name: Open X-Embodiment
description: Aggregated demonstrations from 22 robot embodiments across 21 institutions. The largest cross-embodiment robot dataset. Used to train Octo, RT-2-X, and other foundation models.

name: ALOHA Sim Transfer Cube (Human Demos)
description: 50 teleoperated demonstrations of bimanual cube transfer in the ALOHA MuJoCo sim environment. Reference training data for the ACT paper.
source: Teleoperated in MuJoCo ALOHA sim (Zhao et al. 2023)

name: Push-T Human Demonstrations
description: 200 human demonstrations of the Push-T task collected via keyboard teleoperation. Training data for the Diffusion Policy paper.
source: Keyboard teleoperation in Push-T gym environment (Chi et al. 2023)

name: Robomimic Multi-Human
description: Human demonstrations for 5 Robomimic tasks (Lift, Can, Square, Transport, ToolHang) collected by multiple operators at varying proficiency. Benchmark dataset for imitation learning.

name: Mobile ALOHA Co-Training Data
description: 50 task-specific teleoperated demos (shrimp saute, wine wipe, etc.) combined with 800 base ALOHA episodes for co-training. From Fu et al. 2024.
source: Teleoperated demos + ALOHA base data (Fu, Zhao et al. 2024)

name: SO-100 Community Demos
description: Community-collected teleoperated demonstrations for SO-100 tabletop tasks. Pick-and-place, stacking, and sorting. Growing dataset with contributions from LeRobot Discord.

name: DROID (Distributed Robot Interaction Dataset)
description: 76k demonstrations across 564 scenes and 86 tasks collected on Franka arms across multiple institutions. Large-scale diverse manipulation dataset.

name: Bridge V2
description: 60k demonstrations on WidowX 250 robot across 24 environments in kitchens, sinks, and tabletops. Key dataset for Octo and RT-2-X training.

name: Go2 Isaac Gym Rollouts
description: PPO training rollouts from 4096 parallel Isaac Gym environments for Go2 locomotion. Not teleoperated — generated by RL training. Used for Walk These Ways and Extreme Parkour.

name: RT-1 Everyday Robot Demos
description: 130k real-world episodes from a fleet of 13 Everyday Robots performing over 700 tasks. The largest single-embodiment manipulation dataset. Not publicly released.
